Class SemanticLocatorAgentBridge

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.mcp.SemanticLocatorAgentBridge
public final class SemanticLocatorAgentBridge extends Object
Wires engine SemanticLocatorResolver into shaft-mcp agent locator context (issue #5818 / parent #5457). Builds evidence from capture snapshots (and optional aria forests), resolves with FR-1 precedence, and never silently picks an ambiguous target — payloads retain evidence + confidence (FR-3).
